home.text: Home Product Download Contact Us About Us Welcome for visit our website. Shogun Corporation Limited is a leading and professional CCTV manufacturer located in Hongkong. We specialize in researching, producing and exporting CCTV Cameras and Stand-alone NVRs, providing the most stable digital security solutions. Till now our product range covers Megapixel Cameras, Indoor and Outdoor IP cameras, PTZ IP Cameras and H.265 NVR of more than 120 models. We are willing to make all of our employees be happy in working for Shogun and make all of our reliable customers be successful in cooperation with Shogun. To strengthen our brand Shogun, we have done a series of improvements: We have started to use ERP system to control our whole factory operations to make every process be standard; We certified with ISO9001 & ISO14001 standard. We have built up our own housing factory to design new products to get high competition; We have well-trained our employees to have high work efficiency. Now our production output reaches 30,000 pcs per month, and our sales amounts in 2023 are twofold of 2024.
